mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stronger economic activity, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 1% MoM does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to increased investment in equities and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 3% does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < -0.5% MoM does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate below 2% year-over-year signals a slowing economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 2% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
